newsitem.title: USA: J. Baker names Weinstein CEO.
newsitem.headline: J. Baker names Weinstein CEO.

text.p: J. Baker Inc said Wednesday that its board of directors has elected Alan Weinstein as chief executive officer.
Weinstein has served as acting chief executive officer since the resignation of Jerry Socal in September.
In addition to his new position, Weinstein will retain his title as president of the company.
Additionally, the company confirmed the appointments of Philip Rosenberg to the position of chief financial officer and Mark Beaudouin to first senior vice president and secretary of the company.
